subject.title: fix(tlon): add request timeout to media downloads and image uploads

question: Should Tlon impose a hard 120-second total deadline on remote media fetches, including transfers that are still making progress?
rationale: The shared runtime confirms this setting caps the entire guarded request rather than only connection or response-header inactivity, while the PR does not establish Tlon's acceptable transfer-duration envelope.

options.title: Keep 120 seconds
options.body: Accept that any Tlon remote-media request still incomplete after two minutes follows its existing failure or fallback path.

options.title: Choose a longer deadline
options.body: Set a finite duration based on expected Tlon media sizes and network conditions while retaining protection from indefinite stalls.

options.title: Wait for a narrower timeout
options.body: Avoid a total transfer cap if the intended product behavior is to bound only connection or response-header inactivity.

recommendation.title: Keep 120 seconds
recommendation.body: Accept that any Tlon remote-media request still incomplete after two minutes follows its existing failure or fallback path.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced both affected Tlon paths and is the strongest history-backed owner for their intended request envelope.
